details: Windows 1.0.66: the 8-byte MSTRING_KT8900D magic returned exactly 8 bytes within the 1.5 s timeout instead of the 50-byte ACK+ident, so btech._do_ident reported 'Bad ack from radio'. Same length as the command, so most likely the cable echo with no radio reply (radio off, cable not fully seated, or wrong port/cable). Bytes not logged in 1.0.66. Trace now labels echo-only replies and the error explains them.
summary: Programming command came back as 8 bytes (likely cable echo, radio silent), shown as 'Bad ack'
